Witness W26 (rep 8): cubic 39 edges, bridgeless, girth-5, Aut-1, non-3-edge-colorable via independent backtracker (positives: cube True, Petersen/Blanusa False as expected); G non-Hamiltonian confirmed by two candidate solvers plus audit-independent solver (3626 nodes, start 0) and again by third solver variant (start n//2, reversed order, different pruning) with zero disagreement; all 26 G-v cycles from DRAFT unmapped (new=old for old<v else old-1) and checked edge-by-edge against W26 edge set — all valid, length 26 (25+1). Enumeration completeness: recomputed Aut-orbit counts P: 75 independent pairs in 2 orbits + 15 adjacent pairs in 1 orbit; B18_1: 297 pairs in 85 orbits + 27 adjacents in 9 orbits; B18_2: 297 pairs in 45 orbits + 27 adjacents in 6 orbits, giving (85+45)*1*8=1040 B.P and 2*(9+6)*8=240 P.B =1280 exactly as claimed; dot-product wiring analysis confirms 8 wirings cover block+within-block swaps and unordered orbit reduction is complete; rep-8 provenance (B18_1 ab=[0,4] cd=[1,6] x=0 y=1 wiring 0) recomputed to labeled equality with W26, not just iso; P.P recomputed to exactly 2 types (8+8 wirings). originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp. Nearest priors cited in topic/DRAFT: (1) Goedgebeur-Zamfirescu Improved bounds (hypo to order 17 extended to 14 of order 18 and 34 of order 19, cubic extensions, smallest girth-6 hypo order 25); (2) Goedgebeur-Zamfirescu On Hypohamiltonian Snarks/Fiorini (corrects Fiorini 1983, flower-snark lemma, all-orders hypo-snark existence, Steffen to 36 vertices); (3) Brinkmann-Goedgebeur-Hagglund-Markstrom snark generation to 36 vertices and girth>=6 to 38 / no girth>=7 to 42. None publishes a per-seed-pair census of single Isaacs dot products B18_i . P10 at order 26 with per-graph hypo decisions, girth/Aut/snark table, witness cycles and obstruction list. General existence/counts do not imply provenance-restricted decisions because Fiorini conditions are choice-sensitive. Internal prior scan (13 SCOPE fails, 5 Resultary findings) is disjoint in objects/claims. Direct arXiv fetches for 1602.07171 and 1608.07164 were attempted via webfetch and failed with transport errors (no internet), so verification rests on topic excerpts plus training knowledge; no priority inferred from failed search. Caveat: as unlabeled graphs the 109 types are necessarily a subset of the known all-snarks-to-36 census, so graph novelty is zero; novelty lies only in hypo-by-provenance labels plus Aut/girth breakdown. That delta is narrow but genuinely absent from priors. No restatement of textbook theorem as new; Blanusa=P.P and J5 formula attributions are credited. Hence narrow PASS on originality.

value.rationale: Correct and narrowly new but not independently worth finding later. (a) Snark status for all 109 is an Isaacs-theorem corollary (dot product of snarks is a snark), not a discovery. (b) Girth is universally 5, identical to all seeds (P10/B18_1/B18_2/J5 all girth 5), no record; global smallest girth-6 hypo is order 25 and no-girth>=7-to-42 constraint is respected but yields no record. (c) Claimed within-family extremal Aut=1 is modal (65/109 ~=60%), not rare or surprising; trivial Aut is generic for cubics. Maximal Aut=8 (2 reps) equals seed B18_2 Aut=8, so not distinguishing. No global symmetry/girth extremality. (d) Draft explicitly admits order-26 hypohamiltonian-snark existence per se was already known, so W26 is not an existence breakthrough, only a provenance instance. (e) 87-vs-22 hypo split is presented without structural explanation: no theorem predicting which edge/vertex/wiring choices preserve hypohamiltonicity, no Fiorini-condition analysis, just brute-force table plus first-non-Ham-v list. This is the paradigmatic unexplained enumeration. (f) Seeded-pair slice defined by n1+n2-2 arithmetic (18+10-2=26 as unique single-product order in 22-26 window) is an artificial parameter substitution, not a natural class like all order-26 cubics/snarks (explicitly out of scope). Regeneration takes seconds-minutes with published scripts, so archival value as dataset is minimal and lacks theoretical payoff comparable to SCOPE successes (sharp bounds, records, coupling proofs). Falls under mere parameter substitution / tiny unmotivated gain / unexplained enumeration, which must be rejected even if correct and new.
